# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA

Single drug therapy is as effective as combination therapy once susceptibility results are known.

# Duration of therapy

Treat for 7 days.

---

Therapy:
## Empiric Treatment:

See below for oral therapy or history of multi-drug resistant Pseudomonas
Preferred
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R

< OR >
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q8h extended infusion [R]

Alternative
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h [R,O]

## History of multi-drug resistant Pseudomonas

Consult ID if Carbapenemase gene detected (IMP, KPC, NDM, OXA-48, VIM)

<ADD> Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV once R,O to one of the regimens above

## Oral Step Down Therapy

## if isolate known sensitive to fluoroquinolone

Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO q12h R,DI
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU ABX NOSOCOMIAL P. AERUGINOSA
